name: Vodafone Cook Islands Data Housing & Hosting (national telco hosting service)
developer: Vodafone Cook Islands (Telecom Cook Islands Ltd)
notes: Official Vodafone CK About page lists ICT & Cloud Services including Data Housing & Hosting; business Cloud Services page (checked 2026-08-12) offers Email, Cloud PABX, Data Storage, Website and backup/recovery hosting. Service existence is A-grade official; no public rack count, site count or MW. Telco-hosting/data-centre asset class. Negative evidence as of 2026-08-12: AWS/Azure/GCP/OCI official region pages list no Cook Islands region and PCH/PeeringDB show no local IXP (AS10131 Telecom Cook Islands peers at Equinix Sydney, overseas).

name: Vodafone Cook Islands Avarua data centre
notes: APAC Outlook interview (published 2022-12-02, CEO Phillip Henderson) states Vodafone Cook Islands operates three purpose-built data centres in Avarua, Aroa and Aitutaki offering rack space/entire racks and IaaS to business and government; Avarua and Aroa have on-site O3b satellite connectivity; connectivity via Manatua cable. Avarua DC is on Rarotonga (Avarua district, near OPM/CIG government hub). No public MW or rack count.

name: Vodafone Cook Islands Aroa data centre
notes: APAC Outlook 2022-12-02 profile: purpose-built data centre at Aroa, Rarotonga, part of the three-site Vodafone CK footprint; rack space/entire racks and IaaS; on-site O3b satellite communications; hosts customer/government ICT assets and HaaS hotel workloads. No public MW or rack count.

name: Vodafone Cook Islands Aitutaki data centre
notes: APAC Outlook 2022-12-02 lists the Aitutaki purpose-built data centre as the third Vodafone CK site. Operator-owned LinkedIn (A-social/B) reported completion in 2021-09 of an Aitutaki Data Centre Upgrade: new 10m x 5m building with redundant UPS, backup generator, 24x7 monitored security, redundant air-conditioning and structured cabling. Manatua domestic cable landing is adjacent on Aitutaki. No public MW.

name: Cook Islands Government (CIG) Data Center colocation
developer: Office of the Prime Minister, Government of the Cook Islands (host operator not publicly disclosed)
notes: A-grade procurement: PPCI RFT Data Centre Colocation (tender=3374, published 2020-11-11, closed 2020-12-09) sought an ICT supplier to provide colocation for the CIG Data Center (category 81112000 Data Services; contact OPM Director of ICT, Avarua Rarotonga). B-grade delivery: Aiscorp press release states the government centralised network and data centre colocation was upgraded in December 2021 with the tender awarded to Aiscorp. Colocation host site not publicly disclosed (Rarotonga/Avarua most probable per methodology). Government-data-centre-colocation asset class; small-island grid, no public IT-load/MW evidence.

name: CIG Hyper-Converged Infrastructure & Government ICT Network Upgrade
developer: Office of the Prime Minister, Government of the Cook Islands (implemented by Aiscorp per press release)
notes: A-grade procurement: PPCI RFT Hyper-Converged Infrastructure Implementation & Government ICT Network Upgrade (tender=3361, published 2020-10-23, closed 2020-11-20 amended) and earlier EOI tender=3329 sought software-defined HCI and network for CIG on Rarotonga. Per methodology this is a government-ICT-platform upgrade, not a standalone new data centre. Aiscorp release corroborates Dec 2021 delivery of the centralised network upgrade. No MW/rack data.

name: Manatua / Avaroa Cable Rarotonga landing station (Rutaki)
developer: Avaroa Cables Ltd (ACL), Cook Islands Investment Corporation (CIIC)
notes: Cable-landing asset (NOT a data centre per CK methodology): Manatua 3,600 km two-fiber-pair system ready for service 2020-07-22, brought ashore at Rutaki village, Rarotonga; landing station opened 2022. 10 Tb/s per fibre pair is connectivity capacity, not IT MW. Interconnection anchor for Rarotonga hosting (Vodafone Avarua/Aroa DCs, CIG colocation).

name: Manatua / Avaroa Cable Aitutaki landing station
developer: Avaroa Cables Ltd (ACL), Cook Islands Investment Corporation (CIIC)
notes: Cable-landing asset (NOT a data centre per CK methodology): Aitutaki landing station officially opened 2022-07-11 together with Rarotonga; building houses cable receive equipment, plant and standby generators. ACL reported no downtime since Manatua entered service July 2020 (as of 2022; current status requires live check). Adjacent to Vodafone Aitutaki data centre; 10 Tb/s per fibre pair is connectivity capacity, not IT MW.
